completion_data.completion_summary: Created the complete Zotero extension skeleton at .claude/extensions/zotero/ with 18 files: manifest.json, EXTENSION.md, README.md, index-entries.json, command/skill/agent definitions, 9 script stubs (all exit 2 for graceful degradation), and 2 context file stubs. Extension wired via install-extension.sh with symlinks and index merging.

memory_candidates.content: Extension install-extension.sh only handles symlinks (commands/skills/agents) and index-entries.json merging. It does NOT handle EXTENSION.md -> CLAUDE.md merging. That merge must be done manually by appending the extension's section to .claude/CLAUDE.md.

Extension index-entries.json should use object format {"entries": [...]} (not flat array) to match the install-extension.sh 'object with entries' branch. Include load_when with agents, skills, and commands arrays for broad context discoverability.
